observations: A white game console sits on cardboard boxes, viewed from a top-down angle.
Two boxed 'X6 Wireless Controller' items are shown, labeled third-party/generic, not an official PlayStation DualShock controller.
A power cable with UK-style plug is coiled next to the console.
No rear or side panel, no serial number, model sticker, or port labeling is visible on the console.
No original PlayStation controller, HDMI cable, or power-on screen is shown.
Watermark 'GAME ARENA OFFICIAL' overlays the image; this is a seller mark, not proof of authenticity.

claims.evidence: No model label, serial sticker, or distinguishing Pro-specific marking (e.g., triple-band body line, 'CUH-7xxx' etc.) is visible in photo 0; PS4 Pro units are typically black/two-tone, not plain white as shown.

claims.claim: Ultimate gaming experience / smoother gameplay / faster (implied performance)
claims.evidence: No power-on, boot screen, or gameplay footage shown.

risks.risk: Console model may not actually be a PS4 Pro (could be a standard PS4 or Slim, which are priced very differently)
risks.proof: A clear photo of the rear/side panel showing the model number sticker (e.g., CUH-7xxxB for Pro) or the official PlayStation nameplate
risks.if_unproven: priced as a base-model PS4 of unconfirmed working status, not as a Pro

risks.risk: Console may not power on or may have internal faults (HDD, overheating, disc drive)
risks.proof: A video clip of the console powering on to the home screen, or a screenshot of system settings showing storage/model info

risks.risk: No original DualShock controller included; only generic third-party pads shown, which reduces bundle value and usability
risks.proof: Photo showing an official Sony DualShock controller included in the sale, if any
risks.if_unproven: priced as console-only with no original controller

risks.risk: Possible refurbished, used, or non-functional unit misrepresented as new/working
risks.proof: Photo of original retail box with matching serial number, or unboxing video

proof_requests: Clear photo of the console's rear/bottom panel showing the model number sticker
Video of the console powering on and reaching the home screen
Photo confirming whether an official PlayStation controller is included
Photo of the original retail box, if available
response.reason: The claimed PS4 Pro model cannot be confirmed from the photo (white shell is atypical for Pro, no model sticker visible), and this distinction materially changes the price, so a model-confirming shot is needed before even a worst-case price can be set.
